limitations: No live identity/ARM/binding query this turn; last recorded version is not a fresh production stamp.
No upload, traffic switch, alert authoring, real preview, webhook, broker order, cleanup or credential mutation.
D1 operational-audit writes retain existing best-effort behavior. A storage outage can prevent ingress/refusal receipts; HTTP rejection does not claim storage success.
Diagnostic representation preserves JSON scalar ticker/side/qty values. Secret, extra keys and nested field values are omitted with removedPaths; not wire bytes.
acceptedInstruction denotes authenticated parser/shape acceptance, not ARM permission, broker clearance or execution.
Production response schemas for SELL, SELL_SHORT and BUY_TO_COVER remain unproven; added directional capture tests use clearly synthetic non-2xx bytes.
60-day order lookback gap remains PRINCIPAL_ASSERTED (2026-08-31), not API-proven. Missing/truncated/partial/unreachable reads still refuse.
